nameForm.fullText: Isaiah MUNCE and Rebecca went to live with her daughter and son

note.text: Evidence: Elmira later married into the Kent Co. community when she married Isaiah MUNCE and Rebecca went to live with her daughter and son-in-law in DE. She appears with them in later census records.
